listmonk (REA replay environment)

earakely-scale/ListmonkEnv-REA

Answer factual questions about a seeded listmonk newsletter instance by calling 29 replayed API tools.

Open on Hugging FaceHow to run it

Good for

  • tool-calling evaluation on a real app API
  • CI smoke test for an agentenv stack

Reward

How it is scored
Exact match
Signal
Pass or fail

Each task asks a factual question about a recorded response; reward 1 if the response contains the recorded value, else 0.

How to run it

1. From the cardcopied from the publisher's own instructions

agent-env hf run earakely-scale/ListmonkEnv-REA --bundle listmonk --task smoke          # Docker, no model
agent-env hf run earakely-scale/ListmonkEnv-REA --bundle listmonk --eval listmonk-retrieval --model openai/gpt-oss-120b:groq

2. Get the filesthe whole repository, to a local folder

hf download earakely-scale/ListmonkEnv-REA --repo-type dataset --local-dir ListmonkEnv-REA

Needs: Docker; model endpoint for the evals.
